title: 2022. Convert 1D Array Into 2D Array

examples.explanation: The constructed 2D array should contain 2 rows and 2 columns. The first group of n=2 elements in original, [1,2], becomes the first row in the constructed 2D array. The second group of n=2 elements in original, [3,4], becomes the second row in the constructed 2D array.
The constructed 2D array should contain 1 row and 3 columns. Put all three elements in original into the first row of the constructed 2D array.
There are 2 elements in original. It is impossible to fit 2 elements in a 1x1 2D array, so return an empty 2D array.
